front.title: Live Agent Use Case Extensions for Agentic Dialogs

abstract.t:
Live AI interactions combine ongoing observations, overlapping responses, and changes to the devices through which a user participates. This document contributes three use case extensions to the AgentProto use cases and requirements work: live multimodal calls, AI glasses with companion devices, and embodied systems that converse while performing delegated actions.
For each scenario, the document identifies the existing requirements it builds on, the interoperability questions it raises, and the requirement refinements motivated by its interaction flow. The focus is on independently changing observation sources, response state, participation, and authority within a continuing dialog. The scenarios are independent of transport selection. An appendix uses Media over QUIC Transport (MOQT) to illustrate questions for subsequent binding and application-profile work.
